operations.name: create_api_search_flightdatesmultiarrival
operations.description: Search Wizz Air for available flight dates on a route over a date range. Returns all dates with flights in the window.

args.name: origin
args.description: Departure IATA airport or city code, e.g. "BUD" or "WMI".

args.name: destination
args.description: Arrival IATA airport or city code, e.g. "LON", "LTN", or "STN".

args.name: date
args.description: Start of search window in YYYY-MM-DD format.

args.name: days
args.description: Number of days to search ahead from date (default: 60).

args.name: return
args.description: Search for return flights (flag, default: false).
